symptom: ako/mxcli#2181 (mendixlabs/mxcli#1834): `use building block PlatformDesignSystem.Gallery_List_Divider` failed with "could not expand widget tree: [line 74:37 extraneous input '<' …]"; reproduced on stock Atlas_Web_Content.ListItem_WithImage. `describe page` output of any page with an unbound text-template parameter did not re-parse either.
cause: describe prints a stored Forms$ClientTemplateParameter with AttributeRef null, Expression "" and SourceVariable null as `{1} = <unbound>`, and paramAssignmentV3 accepted only an expression after `=`. Building-block expansion renders the block with the describer and parses it back, so one unbound parameter refused the whole block.
insight: Not a building-block bug: the expansion path is describe -> parse, so it is the describe round-trip invariant, and a block is just where unbound parameters are normal. Making the describer's existing spelling parse kept describe output unchanged; the builders already wrote a parameter with no string value as an empty Forms$ClientTemplateParameter, which is Studio Pro's unbound form, so only grammar and visitor changed. `<unbound>` is one lexer token, not `<` IDENTIFIER `>` (the free param builder has no error channel to refuse `<other>`) and not a keyword `unbound` (that collides with attributes named Unbound wherever a rule takes IDENTIFIER only). `{1} = empty` (the Java-action precedent) was rejected: it is already a valid expression with another meaning. Measured on EvSpike 11.12.1: before, exec failed with the reported error; after, the page is created, mx check reports CE0402 "No value specified." once per unbound parameter and nothing else, binding one with alter page removes its CE0402, and describe -> create or modify -> describe is identical (exec reports Unchanged).
